page.overview:
Who is Butcherman of Kislev?

In the city of Kislev, the Butcherman is a slasher infamous for killing men, women, and children, cutting out their hearts and eating their flesh before disappearing. No one knows who he is or even if he is a man at all. Some claim he is a mutant, that the bodies of his victims are melted from the bone. He has killed many, and the Chekist have yet to capture him.
